lines.surprised: The {name} didn't see Fae coming! It's a little calmer already.
lines.caught: The {name} pounces before Fae is ready!

oldFriends.line: The {name} remembers Fae and calms right down!

hints.charge: Hold, then let go in the green!
hints.catch: Hold up or down to catch each one!
hints.lean: Hold left or right to balance!
hints.trace: Trace the dots before the paint dries!

lines.great: Fae and her friends shine together in a dazzling watercolor swirl!
lines.good: Fae and her friends cheer together! Warm sparkles fill the air.
lines.miss: Everyone tumbles together in a giggly heap, and the critter smiles!

lines.pup: Fae plays her flute! Pond Pup dashes in with a happy bark, calming the air!
lines.squirrel: Fae plays her flute! Acorn Squirrel drops crunchy hazelnuts: +1 leaf and softer bursts!
lines.both: Fae plays her flute! Pond Pup and Acorn Squirrel bound in together, calm and cozy!
